title: Building work in Cefalù: exempt work or a permit?
summary: Building permits for renovation in Italy: separate the work category, local restrictions and other approvals before starting in Sicily.
sections: Describe the actual work

Before calling a job edilizia libera, describe changes to the layout, structure, elevations, use and outdoor areas. Existing drawings, photographs and previous permissions help a qualified professional assess the property. A commercial description such as light refurbishment does not determine its administrative category.
Read the Sicilian framework

D.P.R. 380/2001 must be read as received in Sicily through L.R. 16/2016 and subsequent amendments. Some provisions are received dynamically; others have regional modifications. An example from another Italian region cannot simply be transferred to a property in Cefalù.
A permit is only part of the assessment

Work that does not require a building title may still have to comply with landscape, heritage, structural, hydrogeological or park requirements. Neither a historic-centre address nor a Madonie location identifies every applicable procedure. Ask which authorities and documents are relevant before agreeing a start.
Prepare the discussion

Bring the address, cadastral information, available building records and your intended changes. Ask the professional to distinguish established facts from outstanding checks. A contractor’s quotation describes the proposed scope; it is not permission to build or a certificate of the property's compliance.
faq: Is a small job automatically exempt?
No. Cost and size alone do not determine the procedure: the work, property, location and applicable rules must be assessed.
Does exempt work mean no other approvals?
No. The absence of a building title does not remove relevant restrictions or separate approval requirements.

title: Buying a house to renovate in Sicily: checks before the deed
summary: What to check before buying property in Sicily: cadastral and planning records, restrictions, structure and the right professional enquiries.
sections: Build a complete picture

Buying a house to renovate in Sicily calls for documentary and physical checks, not just a viewing. Request ownership records, cadastral details and plans, available building permissions and documents for previous alterations. The notary and appointed technical professionals have different responsibilities: clarify their respective instructions before committing.
Cadastral and planning checks differ

A matching cadastral plan does not by itself establish that every alteration was lawfully authorised. A qualified professional needs to compare the actual property with the relevant building records and identify missing documents or discrepancies. Do not assume that regularisation is available or automatic.
Condition and restrictions

Cracks, damp or fresh finishes do not establish a diagnosis. Ask what inspections or investigations are appropriate for the structure, roof and installations. The proposed renovation must also be checked against local planning, landscape protection and any park requirements applicable to that location.
Make decisions with the gaps visible

Ask for a written distinction between completed checks and unresolved questions. Any cost assessment should state assumptions and exclusions; our quotation follows a site inspection. This guide belongs to the existing Cefalù buying-guide family and does not replace the notary’s or technical professional’s assessment.
faq: Does cadastral conformity establish planning legality?
No. These are separate checks; the relevant permissions must be reconstructed and compared with the actual property.
Does a visible crack prove a building is unsafe?
Appearance alone does not establish cause or severity. A competent professional decides what further assessment is appropriate.

title: Renovating a house in Italy from abroad: following a Cefalù site
summary: Documented SAL milestones, the works director’s report and WhatsApp updates: the owner-confirmed process for clients living abroad.
sections: From the schedule of quantities to phases

Remote renovation management in Sicily needs a distinction between company coordination and professional supervision. In the process confirmed by the owner, the architect prepares the computo metrico, the measured schedule of works, and divides it into phases. Progress is followed through SAL, stati di avanzamento lavori, or work-progress milestones.
Evidence of a completed phase

Each completed phase is demonstrated to the client through photographic documentation and the report of the geometra or architect acting as direttore dei lavori, the appointed works director, who attests to its completion. This report is distinct from company messages and is not automatically a certificate covering every aspect of the property.
Between milestones

When the technical professional is absent, we update the client through WhatsApp with photos, videos and recordings. These materials help explain progress but do not replace professional supervision or required inspections. No fixed update frequency or guaranteed completion time is promised.
One company contact, five assistance languages

The client has one company contact. The team provides assistance in Italian, English, Dutch, French and Spanish. Website translations do not imply spoken support in all its languages. Before starting, clarify who can authorise changes and expenditure and how these decisions are recorded; this guide does not invent a payment schedule or a contractual variation procedure.
faq: Do WhatsApp photos replace the works director’s report?
No. Informal company updates and professional attestation of a completed phase serve different purposes.
Is spoken support available in every website language?
The confirmed assistance languages are Italian, English, Dutch, French and Spanish. No other spoken language is claimed here.

title: Bespoke concrete dining tables and furniture: finishes and care
summary: Custom concrete furniture and microcement finishes: define the piece, maintenance needs and agreed worldwide shipping or installation.
sections: Specify the piece first

A bespoke concrete dining table starts with dimensions, use, access and its intended setting. Explain where it will stand and any delivery or installation constraints. Shape, support and finish must be specified for that piece; an inspiration image is neither a technical specification nor evidence of a completed company project.
Concrete and microcement are different

A concrete element and a microcement coating are not interchangeable constructions. Ask what structure, substrate and finishing system are proposed, how edges and junctions will be treated and what samples can be considered. A property documented for one product cannot be attributed to every material described as concrete.
Care depends on the real system

Request written instructions for cleaning, compatible products and repairs from the manufacturer or maker of the actual system. Do not assume universal resistance to stains, heat, frost or scratches. Suitability for the intended use requires relevant documentation, not promotional adjectives.
Worldwide furniture, locally focused construction

Bespoke furniture is offered worldwide, with shipping, installation where agreed and team travel arranged for the individual project. Packaging, handling, access and logistical responsibilities must be clear in the quotation. This does not automatically extend the local building service worldwide or imply standard prices and lead times.
faq: Is microcement furniture solid concrete throughout?
Not necessarily. Ask for the structure, substrate and coating system of the specific piece.
Are worldwide delivery conditions identical everywhere?
No. Shipping, handling, access, installation and any team travel must be agreed for the actual destination.

title: CILA, SCIA and permesso di costruire: understanding Sicily’s procedures
summary: An introduction to Italian building procedures without automatically applying examples from other regions to a Sicilian renovation.
sections: Keep the Italian names

CILA is a comunicazione di inizio lavori asseverata, a notice supported by a professional’s certification. SCIA is a segnalazione certificata di inizio attività, a certified commencement notification. A permesso di costruire is an authorising decision. These explanations are not equivalents of your home country's procedures.
Assess the work before choosing a procedure

The professional must establish the actual changes and property history, reading D.P.R. 380/2001 through Sicily’s L.R. 16/2016 and later amendments. Structure, use and external changes need a case-specific assessment. A procedure used on a neighbouring property does not establish the correct route for yours.
Agree responsibilities and documents

Ask who prepares and submits the application or notice, what drawings are required and which separate approvals must be obtained. A building procedure does not replace landscape, structural or environmental requirements. Clarify relevant completion documents and distinguish the contractor’s execution role from professional certifications.
faq: Can I choose whichever procedure is fastest?
No. The applicable procedure depends on the work and law, not the client's preference.
Does submitting a CILA regularise earlier alterations?
Do not assume that a new notice automatically regularises previous unauthorised works. A separate assessment is needed.

title: Geometra, architect and contractor: who does what?
summary: Clarify design, works direction and execution responsibilities before appointing a local building team in Sicily.
sections: Separate the roles

Client, designer, direttore dei lavori and contractor are not interchangeable roles. Clarify the required services and who undertakes them before appointment. A single company contact helps communication but does not automatically combine all technical and professional responsibilities in one person.
Check competence for the actual project

Architects, geometri and engineers act within their qualifications, instructions and applicable professional scope. The title of a guide cannot assign every task to one profession. Structural, safety, geological or other specialist matters may require specific professionals and checks.
Use clear written appointments

Ask for services, deliverables, exclusions and the relationship with construction work to be set out. The contractor executes the agreed works; professional statements must come from the competent appointed people. This guide does not claim particular company staffing, internal licences or professional partnerships.
faq: Is the company contact also the works director?
Not automatically. The actual appointments must identify these separate roles.
Does every project need the same professionals?
No. The necessary specialists depend on the work, property, applicable rules and responsibilities involved.

title: Landscape protection and Cefalù’s historic centre: separate checks
summary: Location, municipal planning and landscape requirements should be checked without assuming that historic-centre status determines one procedure.
sections: Locate the property precisely

The address and cadastral references help the professional identify the property in the relevant instruments. Historic-centre status does not identify every restriction. Planning zones, landscape protection and protection of a cultural asset have distinct bases and must be examined separately.
Read the applicable instruments

The municipal PRG must be read with its rules, drawings and relevant protection measures. The regional July 2026 notice on Palermo’s landscape plan refers to municipal publication and safeguards. The acts applicable to Cefalù must be checked rather than assuming one commencement date from a regional announcement.
Assess the proposed changes

Materials, elevations, roofs and external works may affect the assessment. Ask which authorities and separate approvals are relevant. Do not assume an exemption or simplified procedure just because a nearby property has undergone apparently similar works.
faq: Does historic centre always mean the same protection?
No. Planning definitions and protections must be identified in their respective acts and for the actual location.
Does landscape approval replace building permission?
This must not be assumed. Separate requirements need to be coordinated under the applicable rules.

title: Building or renovating in the Madonie Park: where to start
summary: Check the property’s location, official zoning and park requirements before assuming that work is permissible.
sections: The Madonie and the Park are not identical

A house in the Madonie cannot be assigned to a protected zone from the municipality's name alone. Its location must be checked against the applicable official boundary and zoning. An online map may be old or insufficiently precise for an individual plot.
Establish the zone’s rules

The professional needs to examine the Park’s establishment acts, regulations and current rules alongside relevant municipal instruments. Cefalù’s PRG distinguishes certain park areas from its own scope; this is a reason for further assessment, not permission to transfer rules between zones.
Coordinate separate approvals

A park nulla osta, landscape checks, any habitat assessment and the building title are not synonyms. Official forms identify different channels but do not demonstrate that a particular project is allowed. Clarify necessary acts and their sequence with the professional and competent offices before committing.
faq: Are all Madonie properties inside the Park?
The place name alone cannot establish that. Relevant official boundaries and a precise location are needed.
Does the Park's nulla osta authorise every part of a project?
Not in the abstract. Other required titles, approvals and conditions must also be checked.

title: Swimming pools in Cefalù: feasibility and permissions
summary: Consider the complete works, location and restrictions before choosing a pool, without assumed exemptions or universal size thresholds.
sections: Describe more than the pool shell

A pool project includes associated excavation, installations, drainage, plant spaces and landscaping. Collect information on the ground, access and existing utilities. Descriptions such as above-ground or removable do not settle its legal category by themselves.
Read Sicily’s rules in context

The applicable procedures must be assessed under D.P.R. 380/2001 as received in Sicily and subsequent changes, together with local instruments. A size threshold quoted online is not enough. Landscape, park, structural or hydrogeological requirements may call for additional approvals.
Compare complete proposals

Ask what is included, how water and access are managed and what documentation is required. An attractive design does not prove feasibility or authorisation. This episode updates the existing pools-and-ponds family; an ornamental pond and a swimming pool cannot automatically be treated as the same intervention.
faq: Is a removable pool always permit-free?
No. The actual features, associated works, location and current law must be assessed.
Is there one size limit that applies to every pool?
This guide promises no universal threshold or exemption without checking the rules and individual case.

title: Renovation timing and seasons in Sicily: plan the dependencies
summary: Off-season work, supplies and project phases: build a realistic programme without standard durations or blanket summer bans.
sections: Start with the project

A useful programme separates preliminary checks, design, necessary acts, procurement, execution and completion documents. Each phase depends on earlier decisions and the property's condition. An estimate made without records or a site inspection is not a guaranteed handover date.
Consider actual working conditions

Weather, exposure, access, worker safety and product application conditions can affect planning. Check the instructions for the selected system and any actual local restrictions. This guide does not claim that all Sicilian sites stop in summer or that one season is always best.
Identify decisions and supplies

Material selection, supplier availability and any variation approvals affect the sequence of work. Ask for a programme with stated assumptions and reasoned updates, separating documented progress from forecasts. For a holiday home, agree access and intended use without treating them as a completion guarantee.
faq: How long does a renovation take?
It depends on design, conditions, approvals, supplies and availability. There is no standard duration in this guide.
Is building work always banned in Sicily during summer?
No blanket ban is claimed. Relevant local measures, safety conditions and the particular work must be checked.
